preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control over the marketingAddress
Contract must have BNB balance (from accumulated fees or buybacks)

exploit_hint: The contract uses .transfer() to send BNB to marketingAddress. If the marketingAddress is a contract with a fallback function that consumes more than 2300 gas or reverts, the transfer will fail. As owner, set marketingAddress to a malicious contract that reverts on .transfer() calls, causing BNB to accumulate in the contract. Then use Sweep() function (owner-only) to drain all accumulated BNB to owner address. Alternatively, if you control marketingAddress, make it a contract that reverts on .transfer() to block fee distribution and force BNB accumulation.
